Markdown 转换：全部可用目标Markdown conversions: every available target

Markdown 是这组路线里最像「源文件」的格式：它只有结构，没有版式。所以每条出路的差别不在能不能转，而在目标格式肯不肯接住这些结构——Word 与 HTML 会保留标题、列表与表格，PDF 与图片只留下渲染后的样子，表格数据则要求文档里真的有一张表。Markdown is the closest thing here to a source file: it carries structure, not layout. The routes therefore differ less in whether they work than in what the target is willing to keep — Word and HTML keep headings, lists and tables, PDF and images keep only the rendered look, and spreadsheet targets require the document to actually contain a table.

全部可用目标Every available target

  • HTMLHTML 1 步1 step

    MarkdownMarkdown →HTMLHTML

    浏览器本地把 .md 渲染成可直接双击打开的完整 HTML：GFM 表格与任务列表可用，样式内联，脚本与事件属性在净化阶段移除。Render .md into a complete, double-clickable HTML document locally: GFM tables and task lists work, styles are inlined, scripts and event attributes removed.

    有专页 →Full page →

  • Word (.docx)Word (.docx) 2 步2 steps

    MarkdownMarkdown →HTMLHTML →Word (.docx)Word (.docx)

    在浏览器本地把 .md 转成 .docx：标题层级、列表、表格、代码块写成真实 Word 段落，不是截图。批量、可预览、零网络请求。Convert .md to .docx in your browser: headings, lists, tables and code become real Word paragraphs, not a screenshot. Batch, previewable, zero requests.

    有专页 →Full page →

  • PDFPDF 2 步2 steps

    MarkdownMarkdown →HTMLHTML →PDFPDF

    Markdown → HTML → PDF，本地按 A4 逐页切片成图像型 PDF。好处是哪台机器打开都一样，代价是没有文字层、不可选中检索。Markdown → HTML → PDF, sliced page by page onto A4 locally. It looks identical everywhere; the price is no text layer, so nothing is selectable or searchable.

    有专页 →Full page →

  • Excel (.xlsx)Excel (.xlsx) 4 步4 steps

    MarkdownMarkdown →HTMLHTML →JSONJSON →CSVCSV →Excel (.xlsx)Excel (.xlsx)

    Markdown 表格经 HTML 与 JSON 中转后写成工作表：首行当表头，单元格只保留文本；标题、段落与列表没有单元格可落，不进入结果。Markdown tables travel through HTML and JSON into a worksheet: the first row becomes headers and cells keep their text. Headings, paragraphs and lists have no cell to land in and do not appear.

  • CSVCSV 3 步3 steps

    MarkdownMarkdown →HTMLHTML →JSONJSON →CSVCSV

    把文档里的管道表变成能再计算的 CSV：首行当列名，其余行当记录，数字按值写出不被显示格式改写，文件带 BOM 让 Excel 直接双击不乱码。A pipe table becomes a CSV you can compute on: first row as column names, values written as values, and a BOM so Excel opens the file without mojibake.

    有专页 →Full page →

  • 纯文本 (TXT)plain text (TXT) 2 步2 steps

    MarkdownMarkdown →HTMLHTML →纯文本 (TXT)plain text (TXT)

    按文档顺序提取可读文字：标题、段落、列表与链接文字依次换行，列表编号由 DOM 结构重新生成，脚本与样式整段丢弃；链接地址附在文字后。Readable text is extracted in document order: headings, paragraphs, lists and link text each break the line, list numbers are rebuilt from the DOM, and scripts and styles are dropped whole. Link addresses follow their text.

  • JSONJSON 2 步2 steps

    MarkdownMarkdown →HTMLHTML →JSONJSON

    Markdown 表格写成对象数组：首行是键，每个单元格是字符串；多张表按所在的小标题分组。没有表格时，代码块里的 JSON 会被格式化返回，其它正文报错。Markdown tables become arrays of objects: the first row supplies keys and every cell is a string; several tables are grouped under their headings. With no table, a JSON code block is pretty-printed, and other prose fails.

  • PNGPNG 2 步2 steps

    MarkdownMarkdown →HTMLHTML →PNGPNG

    把渲染后的整页拍成一张 PNG：宽度跟随页面布局，高度随内容增长；超过 32768 px 会报「页面过高」，不静默截断。取不到字节的图片按张数披露。The rendered page is captured as one PNG: width follows the layout and height grows with the content. Past 32768 px the route reports an over-tall page instead of truncating silently, and images without bytes are counted.

  • JPEGJPEG 3 步3 steps

    MarkdownMarkdown →HTMLHTML →PDFPDF →JPEGJPEG

    先按 A4 切成多页，再把每一页编码成 JPEG；多页结果打包成 ZIP，透明区域铺白。长文档得到的是一组页面图，而不是一张压扁的长条。The document is sliced into A4 pages and each page is encoded as JPEG; several pages arrive as a ZIP, with transparent areas filled white. A long document yields a set of page images rather than one flattened strip.

  • WebPWebP 3 步3 steps

    MarkdownMarkdown →HTMLHTML →PDFPDF →WebPWebP

    与 JPEG 共用 A4 分页与栅格化，终点改成 WebP 编码；多页仍打包 ZIP，压缩参数与工作台里的其它 WebP 输出一致。It shares the A4 slicing and rasterisation with JPEG and changes only the final encoder to WebP; several pages still arrive as a ZIP, with the same compression controls as every other WebP output.

这个来源格式的共同限制What holds for every target from this source

  • 源文件先按 BOM / NUL 识别 UTF-16，再按 UTF-8 → GB18030 → GBK 依次解码；四种都不成立时报解码失败，不产出乱码文件Input is decoded UTF-16 (by BOM or NUL spacing), then UTF-8 → GB18030 → GBK; if none of the four works the route reports a decode failure instead of writing mojibake
  • HTML 之外的格式只能看到渲染结果或表格结构：CSS 版式、脚注、mermaid 图与自定义语法会被降级或丢弃Every target except HTML sees either the rendered result or the table structure, so CSS layout, footnotes, mermaid diagrams and custom syntax are flattened or dropped
  • 指向 http(s) 的图片在渲染或打包前被剥掉；相对路径的图片只有在同一批次里也选入那个文件时才有字节可用http(s) images are stripped before rendering or packing; a relative image only has bytes when that file is part of the same batch
  • 一整批文件共用一个目标格式；混合格式批次只提供对所有文件都成立的目标One target format applies to the whole batch; a mixed-format batch only offers targets that work for every file in it

常见问题Questions people actually ask

Markdown 转 PDF 后还能选中文字吗？Is the text in a Markdown to PDF result selectable?

不能。这条路线先把 Markdown 渲染成 HTML，再整页拍成图像切片写入 PDF，所以 PDF 里是页面图像，不是文字层。要可编辑的文档请选 Word；要能被搜索的文字请选 HTML 或 TXT。No. The route renders Markdown to HTML and slices that rendering into page images, so the PDF holds pictures of pages rather than a text layer. Choose Word for an editable document, or HTML/TXT when the text itself has to stay searchable.

为什么 Markdown 转 Excel 要求文档里有表格？Why does Markdown to Excel need a table in the document?

Excel 的每一格都要求行列坐标，而标题和段落没有坐标。转换器先找 Markdown 表格（或一段能被当作 JSON 数组读的代码块），找不到就报错，而不是交出一张空表。Every Excel cell needs a row and a column, and a heading or paragraph has neither. The converter looks for a Markdown table, or a code block that parses as a JSON array, and fails when there is none rather than handing back an empty sheet.

链接和图片会跟着走吗？Do links and images travel with the result?

链接会：HTML 与 Word 保留可点击的地址，TXT 会把地址附在链接文字后面。图片分两种：data URI 内嵌的会跟着走；指向网络或相邻路径的取不到字节，渲染类目标会按张数披露。Links do: HTML and Word keep clickable addresses, and TXT appends the address after the link text. Images depend on where the bytes are — embedded data URIs travel, while network or sibling-path references have no bytes and rendering targets count them in the drop disclosure.

一次能转多少个文件？How many files can one batch hold?

最多 200 个文件，单个文件上限 100 MB；超过 5 个文件或 20 MB 的批次会先弹确认。每个文件独立执行路线，一个失败不会阻断其余文件。Up to 200 files and 100 MB per file; a batch over five files or 20 MB asks for confirmation first. Each file walks the route on its own, so one failure does not stop the rest.

不需要账号，也不需要联网：装好扩展后点图标，在新标签页里打开工作台，文件从磁盘直接选。No account and no network: install the extension, click its icon, and the workbench opens in a new tab reading straight off your disk.
